descriptionHtml:
The IEEE WIE Affinity Group of the University of Peradeniya successfully organized the TeleNex Session on 17th September 2026 at the Smart Room of the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (DEEE). The session focused on telecommunications, industrial communication, and global opportunities, providing participants with valuable insights into modern telecommunication technologies and their practical applications.

Ms. Michelle Fernando shared her professional journey and industry experience, highlighting the connection between academic knowledge and real-world engineering practices. The session also explored global career and professional opportunities in the telecommunications field, offering participants a broader understanding of the industry and its future prospects.

The session was attended by approximately 50 participants, demonstrating the interest of students in exploring telecommunications and industrial communication. The event served as a valuable platform for learning, professional exposure, and gaining insights into potential career pathways within the field.

The IEEE WIE Affinity Group extends its sincere appreciation to Ms. Michelle Fernando for sharing her knowledge and experience, and to all participants and contributors who supported the successful conduct of the session.
